hooks.command: bash -c 'cmd=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$cmd" in *"rm -rf /"*|*"rm -rf ~"*|*"rm -rf $HOME"*) echo "BLOCKED: rm -rf on root/home is not allowed" >&2; exit 2;; *"git push --force"*|*"git push -f "*) echo "BLOCKED: force push is not allowed" >&2; exit 2;; *"git reset --hard"*) echo "BLOCKED: git reset --hard is not allowed" >&2; exit 2;; *"git clean -f"*|*"git clean -fd"*) echo "BLOCKED: destructive git clean is not allowed" >&2; exit 2;; *"npm publish"*|*"yarn publish"*|*"pnpm publish"*) echo "BLOCKED: publishing packages is not allowed" >&2; exit 2;; esac'
